annotations.title: How typical trading styles do on an account

description: Eleven sample traders (breakout, trend following, mean reversion, scalping, swing trading, opening range breakout, day trading, high win rate, low win rate, position trading, and a grid sample with no edge) replayed 1,000 times against each account's rules: pass and first-payout chance, best risk per trade, typical days and the usual reason for failing. Give id for every style on one account, or style for the accounts where that style does best. They show how rules treat a style, not anyone's own odds.

style.description: A sample style, to rank accounts for it.
